pt-br:browser.server.route.3.text: Este perfil do navegador não está mais disponível. Escolha um perfil na guia Navegador.
pt-br:browser.server.route.3.en: This browser profile is no longer available. Choose a profile in the Browser tab.

pt-br:highlevel.canChangeHelp.text: Você aprova cada alteração neste computador primeiro. No modo Sem limites, as alterações são feitas sem perguntar.
pt-br:highlevel.canChangeHelp.en: You approve each change on this computer first. On No limits, changes happen without asking.

pt-br:highlevel.missingScopes.text: O HighLevel precisa destas permissões no seu token: {names}.
pt-br:highlevel.missingScopes.en: HighLevel needs these permissions on your token: {names}.

pt-br:highlevel.engineUnsupported.text: A IA deste bot ainda não pode usar o HighLevel. Troque para Fuigo ou outra IA.
pt-br:highlevel.engineUnsupported.en: This bot's AI can't use HighLevel yet. Switch it to Fuigo or another AI.

pt-br:highlevel.onComputerGrant.text: Ative isto pelo Murage no seu computador.
pt-br:highlevel.onComputerGrant.en: Turn this on from Murage on your computer.

pt-br:highlevel.approvalNote.text: As alterações podem executar automações já configuradas neste CRM.
pt-br:highlevel.approvalNote.en: Changes may run automations already set up in this CRM.

pt-br:highlevel.valuesFailed.text: Não foi possível carregar a alteração. Permitir fica desativado até que ela seja carregada.
pt-br:highlevel.valuesFailed.en: Could not load the change. Allow stays off until it loads.

pt-br:highlevel.onComputer.text: Abra o Murage no seu computador para ver os valores exatos e aprovar.
pt-br:highlevel.onComputer.en: Open Murage on your computer to see the exact values and approve.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.limit.text: Você atingiu seu limite mensal de {limit}.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.unknown.text: O Murage não consegue consultar o valor do Flux Router agora.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.unknown.en: Murage cannot read Flux Router's figure right now.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.otherAccount.text: Esta chave do Flux Router pertence a outra conta Flux, então o limite do Murage não pode incluir o uso dela.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.otherAccount.en: This Flux Router key is on another Flux account, so Murage's limit cannot count it.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.noAccount.line.text: Esta chave do Flux Router não pertence a uma conta Flux, então o limite do Murage não pode incluir o uso dela.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.noAccount.line.en: This Flux Router key is not on a Flux account, so Murage's limit cannot count it.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxKey.text: O limite desta chave no Flux Router foi atingido.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxKey.en: Flux Router reached this key's limit.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxTokens.text: O limite de tokens desta chave no Flux Router foi atingido.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxTokens.en: Flux Router reached this key's token limit.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxBot.text: O limite deste bot no Flux Router foi atingido.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxBot.en: Flux Router reached this bot's limit.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxAlso.text: O limite definido no Flux Router para esta chave também se aplica.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.fluxAlso.en: Flux Router's own limit for this key also applies.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.emailOnly.text: Só o e-mail de {bot} fica em espera.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.title.text: Por enquanto, o limite do Murage serve apenas como aviso
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.title.en: Murage's limit is a heads-up only for now

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.body.text: O Flux Router parou de enviar o valor da conta de que o Murage precisa para pausar ao atingir seu limite. Seus bots continuam trabalhando e o indicador ainda avisa em 80% e 100%. Os limites que você define no Flux Router continuam valendo.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.body.en: Flux Router stopped sending the account figure Murage needs to pause at your limit. Your bots keep working and the meter still warns you at 80% and 100%. Limits you set inside Flux Router still apply.

pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.promiseOff.text: Se o Flux Router parar de fornecer o valor da conta, o limite volta a servir apenas como aviso e o Murage informa você.
pt-br:ux.l2c.pause.promiseOff.en: If Flux Router stops offering the account figure, the limit goes back to a heads-up only and Murage tells you.

zh:browser.server.browser-extension-setu.en: The task could not continue. Send a new message when you are ready.

zh:browser.server.browser-mode-transitio.en: Another bot is using your Chrome. Move it to its own browser first.

zh:browser.server.browser-open-chrome.3.text: 请在此电脑上打开 Google Chrome，然后重试。
zh:browser.server.browser-open-chrome.3.en: Open Google Chrome on this computer, then try again.

zh:browser.server.route.2.text: 请在“浏览器”选项卡中选择浏览器配置文件。

zh:browser.server.route.3.en: This browser profile is no longer available. Choose a profile in the Browser tab.

zh:browser.server.route.4.text: 另一个机器人正在使用你的 Chrome，或旧连接仍在关闭中。
zh:browser.server.route.4.en: Another bot is using your Chrome, or the old connection is still closing.

zh:browser.server.route.18.en: Choose another browser profile for these bots before deleting this profile.

zh:highlevel.canChangeHelp.text: 每次更改都需要先在此电脑上批准。在无限制模式下，更改无需询问即可执行。
zh:highlevel.canChangeHelp.en: You approve each change on this computer first. On No limits, changes happen without asking.

zh:highlevel.fullHelp.text: 完全控制还允许删除、发送发票和付款以及更改用户。这些操作仍会请求批准，除非机器人处于无限制模式且你正在电脑前。
zh:highlevel.fullHelp.en: Full control can also delete, send invoices and payments, and change users. Those still ask you unless the bot is on No limits and you are at your computer.

zh:highlevel.missingScopes.text: HighLevel 需要你的令牌具有以下权限：{names}。
zh:highlevel.missingScopes.en: HighLevel needs these permissions on your token: {names}.

zh:highlevel.engineUnsupported.text: 此机器人的 AI 暂时无法使用 HighLevel。请切换到 Fuigo 或其他 AI。
zh:highlevel.engineUnsupported.en: This bot's AI can't use HighLevel yet. Switch it to Fuigo or another AI.

zh:highlevel.onComputerGrant.text: 请在电脑上的 Murage 中启用此功能。
zh:highlevel.onComputerGrant.en: Turn this on from Murage on your computer.

zh:highlevel.approvalNote.text: 更改可能触发此 CRM 中已设置的自动化流程。
zh:highlevel.approvalNote.en: Changes may run automations already set up in this CRM.

zh:highlevel.valuesLoading.text: 正在加载确切的更改内容...

zh:highlevel.valuesFailed.text: 无法加载更改。加载完成前，“允许”按钮将保持禁用。
zh:highlevel.valuesFailed.en: Could not load the change. Allow stays off until it loads.

zh:highlevel.onComputer.text: 请在电脑上打开 Murage，查看确切的值并批准。
zh:highlevel.onComputer.en: Open Murage on your computer to see the exact values and approve.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.limit.text: 你已达到每月 {limit} 的限额。

zh:ux.l2c.pause.unknown.text: Murage 目前无法读取 Flux Router 的金额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.unknown.en: Murage cannot read Flux Router's figure right now.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.otherAccount.text: 此 Flux Router 密钥属于另一个 Flux 账户，因此其用量无法计入 Murage 的限额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.otherAccount.en: This Flux Router key is on another Flux account, so Murage's limit cannot count it.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.noAccount.line.text: 此 Flux Router 密钥未关联任何 Flux 账户，因此其用量无法计入 Murage 的限额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.noAccount.line.en: This Flux Router key is not on a Flux account, so Murage's limit cannot count it.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxKey.text: 此密钥已达到 Flux Router 中的限额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxKey.en: Flux Router reached this key's limit.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxTokens.text: 此密钥已达到 Flux Router 中的令牌限额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxTokens.en: Flux Router reached this key's token limit.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxBot.text: 此机器人已达到 Flux Router 中的限额。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxBot.en: Flux Router reached this bot's limit.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxAlso.text: Flux Router 为此密钥设置的限额也会生效。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.fluxAlso.en: Flux Router's own limit for this key also applies.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.emailOnly.text: 只有 {bot} 的电子邮件在等待。

zh:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.title.text: Murage 的限额目前仅作提醒
zh:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.title.en: Murage's limit is a heads-up only for now

zh:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.body.text: Flux Router 已停止发送账户金额，Murage 需要该金额才能在达到限额时暂停工作。你的机器人会继续工作，用量指示器仍会在 80% 和 100% 时提醒你。在 Flux Router 中设置的限额仍然有效。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.body.en: Flux Router stopped sending the account figure Murage needs to pause at your limit. Your bots keep working and the meter still warns you at 80% and 100%. Limits you set inside Flux Router still apply.

zh:ux.l2c.pause.promiseOff.text: 如果 Flux Router 不再提供账户金额，限额将恢复为仅作提醒，Murage 会通知你。
zh:ux.l2c.pause.promiseOff.en: If Flux Router stops offering the account figure, the limit goes back to a heads-up only and Murage tells you.
